_doc: Result-change notices: one per (slug, outcome) whose served pooled result changed. before/after are the served and the rebuilt result tuples (k, estimate, ci_low, ci_high) read from the review objects; left_pool/entered_pool name every trial that moved; the honest ratchet refuses a landing whose result differs from the served one without an exact notice; the page renders each notice beside the outcome and names a reversal of significance as a withdrawal of the previous conclusion. reviewer_countersignature: OPEN until the reviewer has SEEN the rendered notice; SEEN_AND_SIGNED (per notice; the only signature a withdrawn conclusion accepts) or BATCH_SEEN_AND_SIGNED (direction-preserving changes, batch_id named) carry by, when_utc, the sha256 of the rendered block that was signed, and how_it_reached_the_reviewer (the rendered block itself, or a relay and what the relay conveyed); there is no 'agreed in advance'.

notices.reason: FLOW (PMID 38785209, NCT03819153) and ELIXA (PMID 26630143, NCT01147250) enter the CONVENTIONAL_GLP1RA primary pool under the protocol's B-prime rules (b10c53d3), each from a committed result-level adjudication whose every field carries a witness span re-verified against sha256-pinned held bytes (evidence/glp1_adjudication/FLOW.json, ELIXA.json). FLOW: 3-point MACE HR 0.82 (0.68-0.98), 212 vs 254, kept distinct from the kidney composite 0.76 by table row. ELIXA: 3-point MACE HR 1.02 (0.887-1.172), 400 vs 392, identified by its source row -- FDA statistical review Table 8 'Analysis of the MACE Endpoint', row 'MACE endpoint (on-study)' -- the definition of that label and its event counts, never by its number: the 4-point MACE+ primary is printed with the same HR 1.02 (0.89, 1.17) (Table 1, 406 vs 399) and is refused as a different outcome. ELIXA PRESPECIFICATION DISPUTE: the FDA statistical review calls the 3-point MACE a secondary endpoint analysed by a pre-specified Cox model; the FDA summary review calls it a sensitivity analysis; the registry lists the 4-point primary and secondary 5- and 6-point composites but no 3-point MACE. The same statistical review renders the 3-point interval three ways: (0.887, 1.172) in the section 3.3.4.3 text, (0.89, 1.18) in Table 8 and (0.89, 1.17) in the executive summary; the unrounded text interval is pooled (Table 8 rendering: k=10, 0.861, 0.807-0.919 either way). FREEDOM-CVO stays out: eligible only on the GLP1RA_ANY_DELIVERY strand. Conclusion unchanged in direction and significance; heterogeneity is no longer ~0 (tau2 0.00004 -> 0.0027) and the prediction interval widens from 0.807-0.908 to 0.753-0.985.
notices.by: evidence lane (Claude Opus 5.5), branch evid/glp1-admission; V1.0.1, lands only after Mahmood's hash-bound signature
